description: This file defines the `HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator` class, which extends `FilterIterator` to create a custom iterator that filters keys based on a specified prefix. It includes a constructor to initialize the iterator and filter, and an `accept` method to determine if the current element matches the filter criteria.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_PropertyListIterator
classes.description: A custom iterator class extending PHP's FilterIterator to filter elements based on a prefix match in their keys.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a given iterator and an optional filter string.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if the current element's key starts with the specified filter prefix.
